# All options

Every setting eda-agent has, in one place: command-line flags, environment variables, the Config tab, `workspace.json` and the profile files with fixed keys. This page is generated from the code, and a test fails when a setting is added without a line here.

For a short tour of the ones most people change, see [Configuration](CONFIGURATION.md).

## Environment variables

Set them in your MCP client's server config (an `env` block), or for your Windows user with `setx NAME value`. The server reads your saved user environment too, so no restart of the client is needed after `setx` for the Altium 365 settings.

### Server and tool surface

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_BACKEND` | altium | Which EDA tool to drive: `altium`, `kicad`, `easyeda`, or `both` (Altium and KiCad together). Same as `--backend`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_TOOLSET` | full | `minimal` advertises only `tool_catalog` and `tool_invoke`, for MCP clients that cap the tool count. Every tool stays reachable. Same as `--toolset`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_COMPUTE` | python | `python`, `rust` or `auto`: which implementation runs the CPU-heavy loops. See [Rust compute](RUST_COMPUTE.md). Same as `--compute`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ROUTER` | the profile's `router.json`, else `default` | Which autorouter engine routing runs use: `default`, or `euan` for the alternative router from Euan's fork (off unless set). Overrules `eda-agent router-use`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_REMINDER_EVERY` | 10 | How often `app_ping` / `app_attach` repeat the datasheet-first reminder: on the first call, then every Nth. `1` sends it every time. |
| `EDA_AGENT_HEADLESS_REVIEW` | off | `1` enables the offline review, BOM and netlist commands and tools that read `.SchDoc`/`.PrjPcb` files with no Altium running. Same as `--offline` on those commands. |

### Workspace and Altium bridge

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_WORKSPACE` | `%USERPROFILE%\EDA Agent\workspace` | The folder Python and the Altium script exchange request and response files through. Must agree on both sides; `eda-agent health` checks it. |
| `EDA_AGENT_POINTER_FILE` | `C:\ProgramData\eda-agent\workspace-path.txt` | Where Python writes the resolved workspace path for the Altium script to read (DelphiScript cannot read environment variables). Mainly for tests. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM_PROCESS` | `X2.exe`, then `DXP.exe` | The Altium process name `doctor` and the bridge look for, if yours differs. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM_DIR` | found from the registry | Altium's install folder, used to read its translated menu and dialog captions. Set it to aim at a second Altium version. |
| `EDA_AGENT_KEEP_BOARD_IN_VIEW` | off | `1` fits the board or sheet in view after each edit, at most every two seconds. Same as Keep board in view on the Config tab; either one turns it on. |

### Safety and what the AI may do

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_READONLY` | off | `1` refuses every command that is not a read. The stricter of this and the Config tab's Edits switch wins. |
| `EDA_AGENT_UI_AUTOMATION` | on | `0` (or `false`, `no`, `off`) refuses every synthesised keystroke, click and menu pick. Reading dialogs stays on. Read on every event, so it takes effect at once. |

### Web dashboard

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_NO_DASHBOARD` | off | `1` starts the MCP server without the web dashboard. Same as `--no-dashboard`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_DISABLE_DASHBOARD` | off | Alias of `EDA_AGENT_NO_DASHBOARD`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_HEADLESS` | off | Alias of `EDA_AGENT_NO_DASHBOARD`. Same as `--headless`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_DASHBOARD_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | loopback only | Comma-separated host names (no ports) the dashboard accepts in `Host` and `Origin`, for a deliberate non-loopback `--host`. |

### Logs and token usage

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_LOG_DIR` | `%USERPROFILE%\EDA Agent\logs` | Folder of the rotating, secret-redacting server log. |
| `EDA_AGENT_LOG_MAX_MB` | 10 | Rotate a log file at this size. |
| `EDA_AGENT_LOG_BACKUPS` | 5 | Rotated log files kept. |
| `EDA_AGENT_LOG_TOTAL_MAX_MB` | 200 | Hard cap for the whole log folder. The oldest rotated files go first. |
| `EDA_AGENT_LOG_MIN_FREE_MB` | 1024 | Below this much free disk, DEBUG and INFO logging stop and one CRITICAL line says why. |
| `EDA_AGENT_USAGE_OFF` | off | `1` stops counting the tokens each tool call costs. Same as `usage_stats: off` in preferences. See [Token usage](TOKEN_USAGE.md). |
| `EDA_AGENT_USAGE_DIR` | the design workspace | Where the token usage files are kept. |

### Profiles, policies and design modes

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_PROFILE_DIR` | unset | A profile folder to use, ahead of a project-local `.eda-agent/profile/` and the central `profile-use` choice. See [Profiles](PROFILES.md). |
| `EDA_AGENT_PHASES` | the profile's `phase_gates.json`, else none | NPI stages to run, comma-separated (`evt,dvt,pvt`), `all`, or `none`. Overrules the profile. Same as `--phases`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_MODE` | the profile's `default_mode`, else `full_design` | The design mode a run uses when it names none. Same as `--mode`. See [Design modes](DESIGN_MODES.md). |
| `EDA_AGENT_POLICY_DIR` | unset (nothing imposed) | Folder of company policy files: `naming.json` for `lib_check_naming` / `lib_make_name`, and `rules/*.json` for `design_check_company_rules`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_IPC_DIR` | the bundled data | Folder with your own `ipc7351b_goals.json`, `company_goals.json` and `naming.json` for the IPC-7351 footprint tools. `ALTIUM_AI_IPC_DIR` is read as an older name for it. |
| `ALTIUM_AI_IPC_DIR` | unset | Older name for `EDA_AGENT_IPC_DIR`, still read. |

### Altium 365 and Nexar

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_NEXAR_APP_ID` | unset | Your Nexar app's client id. Turns on the Nexar route; sign in once with `eda-agent altium365-login`. With the secret below it also serves the `nexar` part search when `NEXAR_CLIENT_ID` is unset. |
| `EDA_AGENT_NEXAR_CLIENT_SECRET` | unset | The client secret of an app made in the Nexar portal. Sent only to Nexar's token endpoint. Set it with `setx`, never in a chat. The `nexar` part search uses it with the app id above when `NEXAR_CLIENT_SECRET` is unset. |
| `EDA_AGENT_NEXAR_REDIRECT` | `http://localhost:3000/login` | The redirect URL registered on your Nexar app, if it differs. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM365_DOMAIN` | unset | Your workspace host, for the direct route to the workspace's own API. Wins over Nexar when set. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM365_TOKEN` | unset | A workspace API token for the direct route (only plans whose admin pages offer API tokens). |
| `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM365_WORKSPACES` | every workspace the account reaches | Comma-separated workspace URLs the `altium365_` tools may act on. `eda-agent start` sets it from `workspace.json`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM365_TIMEOUT_S` | 60 | Seconds each Altium 365 request may take. |

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_PART_PROVIDERS` | none | Comma-separated part providers to enable for `part_search` and `part_fetch`. See [Part sourcing](PART_SOURCING.md). |
| `EDA_AGENT_CACHE_DIR` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\eda-agent\parts-cache` | Where provider indexes and cached datasheets are kept. |
| `EDA_AGENT_DATASHEET_HOSTS` | none (deny by default) | Comma-separated hosts `part_cache_datasheet` may download from. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM_LIBRARIES` | `%PUBLIC%\Documents\Altium\Library` and the Library and Projects folders under `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\Altium` | Folders the `altium_local` provider searches, separated by `;` on Windows. |
| `EDA_AGENT_KICAD_SYMBOL_DIR` | `KICAD_SYMBOL_DIR`, then the KiCad install | KiCad symbol libraries for the `kicad_local` provider. |
| `EDA_AGENT_KICAD_FOOTPRINT_DIR` | `KICAD_FOOTPRINT_DIR`, then the KiCad install | KiCad footprint libraries for the `kicad_local` provider. |
| `EDA_AGENT_KICAD_3DMODEL_DIR` | `KICAD_3DMODEL_DIR`, then the KiCad install | KiCad 3D models for the `kicad_local` provider. |
| `KICAD_SYMBOL_DIR` | KiCad's own | KiCad's standard variable, used when the `EDA_AGENT_` one is unset. |
| `KICAD_FOOTPRINT_DIR` | KiCad's own | KiCad's standard variable, used when the `EDA_AGENT_` one is unset. |
| `KICAD_3DMODEL_DIR` | KiCad's own | KiCad's standard variable, used when the `EDA_AGENT_` one is unset. |

### Simulation

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_LTSPICE_EXE` | found on the machine | Path to the LTspice executable. |

| `EDA_AGENT_LTSPICE_MODEL_ROOTS` | none | Extra folders of LTspice models a deck may include, separated by `;` on Windows. |

| `EDA_AGENT_THERMAL_RUNS` | `%USERPROFILE%\EDA Agent\thermal` | Where each `sim_thermal_analysis` run writes its heat maps, fields and report, one folder per run. |
| `EDA_AGENT_PDN_RUNS` | `%USERPROFILE%\EDA Agent\pdn` | Where `sim_pdn_ir_drop` and `sim_pdn_impedance` write their maps, curves and SPICE decks, one folder per run. |
| `EDA_AGENT_SIM_JOBS` | `%USERPROFILE%\EDA Agent\jobs` | Where simulation jobs (`sim_job_run`, the dashboard's Simulation page) keep their folders: one per problem, one subfolder per engine. |

| `EDA_AGENT_OPENEMS_PYTHON` | this Python, then `python` on PATH | A Python that can `import openEMS`, used to run the solver. |

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_EASYEDA_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Address the server listens on for the EasyEDA Pro extension. |

### Updates and development

| Variable | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `EDA_AGENT_UPDATE_CHECK` | 1 | `0` stops the hourly background check for new commits from reaching the network. |
| `EDA_AGENT_ASSUME_YES` | off | `1` answers yes to overwrite prompts in the CLI, like `--force`. |
| `EDA_AGENT_RELOAD` | off | `1` runs the server behind a reloading proxy, so Python edits take effect without reconnecting the client. |

### Part provider credentials

Each catalogue provider reads its own credentials. Enable the provider with `EDA_AGENT_PART_PROVIDERS` as well.

| Provider | Variables |
|---|---|
| `digikey` | `DIGIKEY_CLIENT_ID`, `DIGIKEY_CLIENT_SECRET` |
| `element14` | `ELEMENT14_API_KEY` |
| `mouser` | `MOUSER_API_KEY` |
| `nexar` | `NEXAR_CLIENT_ID`, `NEXAR_CLIENT_SECRET`, or else `EDA_AGENT_NEXAR_APP_ID`, `EDA_AGENT_NEXAR_CLIENT_SECRET` |
| `tme` | `TME_TOKEN`, `TME_SECRET` |

## Config tab and `preferences.json`

The Config tab on the Altium status window writes these to `preferences.json` in the workspace. A profile may carry its own `preferences.json` with the same keys plus `default_mode`. For the safety switches the stricter of the two wins; for the rest the profile wins. The first value listed is the default.

| Key | Values | Safety switch | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value_format` | `none`, `rkm`, `si` |  | How a component value is written when it is cleaned up: `none` leaves it as written, `rkm` gives 4K7 / 2u2, `si` gives 4.7k / 2.2u. |
| `value_unit` | `without`, `with` |  | Under `si`, `with` adds the unit (100nF, 3.3V; never on resistors). Always `without` under `rkm`. |
| `edits` | `allowed`, `readonly` | yes | `readonly` refuses every command that is not a read. Safety switch: the stricter setting wins. |
| `deleting` | `allowed`, `refused` | yes | `refused` turns away commands that delete or remove. Safety switch. |
| `closing` | `allowed`, `refused` | yes | `refused` turns away commands that close a document or project. Safety switch. |
| `ui_automation` | `on`, `off` | yes | `off` refuses menus, dialogs and keystrokes. Safety switch. |
| `keep_in_view` | `off`, `on` |  | `on` fits the board or sheet in view after each edit. |
| `dialogs` | `auto`, `manual` |  | `manual` leaves dialogs such as the change order for you to answer, instead of the tool answering them. |
| `usage_stats` | `on`, `off` |  | `off` stops counting the tokens each tool call costs. |
| `theme` | `system`, `light`, `dark` |  | The web dashboard's look: `system`, `light` or `dark`. Set in the profile only; the Altium panel has no switch for it. |
| `length_units` | `mil`, `mm` |  | The unit a new AI session gives and reads lengths in: `mil` (default) or `mm`. Each session may change its own with the `length_units` tool. |
| `default_mode` | a design mode name | | Profile only: the design mode a run uses when it names none. |

## `workspace.json`

`<workspace>/.eda-agent/workspace.json` is what `eda-agent start` reads to bring a design workspace up. Unknown keys are refused, and so is anything that looks like a secret: keep secrets in your user environment.

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| `altium365_workspaces` | Altium 365 workspace URLs (https://) the `altium365_` tools may act on here. Exported as `EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM365_WORKSPACES`. |
| `dashboard_port` | The web dashboard's port for this workspace (0 = the default). |
| `profile` | The owner profile `eda-agent start` activates for this workspace. |

## Profile files with fixed keys

A profile also holds naming, design rules, ERC levels, fab profiles, modes and templates, described in [Profiles](PROFILES.md). These files have a fixed set of keys, and `eda-agent profile-validate` refuses any other:

### `footprint_defaults.json`

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| `pad_corner_radius_pct` | Pad corner rounding in percent (0 to 100) used when a footprint tool is given none. |

### `document_settings.json`

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| `pcb_units` | Units for new boards (documentation only: no bridge command sets them on a live board). |
| `schematic_snap_grid_mil` | Schematic snap grid, in mils. |
| `schematic_units` | Units for new schematic documents. |
| `schematic_visible_grid_mil` | Schematic visible grid, in mils. |

### `phase_gates.json`

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| `stages` | The NPI stages this owner runs, e.g. `["evt", "dvt", "pvt"]`. Absent means none. |

## Command line

Flags that apply to every command (put them before the command):

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--no-dashboard` | switch | Skip the in-process web dashboard. Required by strict MCP stdio clients (Codex, etc) that can't tolerate the dashboard thread's side-effects. Equivalent to setting EDA_AGENT_DISABLE_DASHBOARD=1 / EDA_AGENT_HEADLESS=1. |
| `--headless` | switch | Alias for --no-dashboard. |
| `--backend` | `altium`, `kicad`, `easyeda`, `both` | Which EDA tool to drive (default: altium). Selects the tool surface: 'altium' is the full Altium suite, 'kicad' the KiCad-native tools, 'easyeda' the EasyEDA Pro tools, 'both' the union of Altium and KiCad. Equivalent to setting EDA_AGENT_BACKEND. |
| `--compute` | `python`, `rust`, `auto` | Which implementation runs the CPU-heavy loops (default: python). 'rust' uses the optional eda-agent-compute wheel and refuses to start without it; 'auto' uses it when installed. Same results either way. Equivalent to setting EDA_AGENT_COMPUTE. See docs/RUST_COMPUTE.md. |
| `--toolset` | `full`, `minimal` | How many tools to advertise (default: full). 'minimal' exposes only tool_catalog and tool_invoke, keeping every other tool reachable through them, for MCP clients that limit tool count or are slow to load hundreds of schemas. Equivalent to setting EDA_AGENT_TOOLSET. |
| `--phases` | `STAGES` | Which NPI stages to run, comma-separated: feasibility, research, prototype, evt, dvt, pvt, or 'all'. Default: none, which leaves the three design_phase_* tools unadvertised. 'none' turns the gate off over a profile that turned it on. Equivalent to setting EDA_AGENT_PHASES. |
| `--mode` | `MODE` | The design mode a run uses when it names none: full_design, schematic_only, layout_only, reference_redraw, devkit_derivative, reusable_block, or one from the profile's modes/. Equivalent to setting EDA_AGENT_MODE; see mode-list. |

### Server and setup

#### `eda-agent serve`

Run the MCP server on stdio (default when no args given)

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--no-dashboard` | switch | Skip the in-process web dashboard (see top-level flag). |
| `--headless` | switch | Alias for --no-dashboard. |
| `--backend` | `altium`, `kicad`, `easyeda`, `both` | Which EDA tool to drive (see top-level flag). |

#### `eda-agent start`

Bring a design workspace up: its profile, dashboard, doctor and Altium 365 login, from <workspace>/.eda-agent/workspace.json.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--workspace` | `WORKSPACE` | Workspace folder (default: found from the current one). |
| `--init` | switch | Write or update the workspace's settings file and stop. |
| `--profile` | `PROFILE` | Central profile to activate. |
| `--port` | `PORT` | Dashboard port. |
| `--altium365-workspace` | `URL` | Altium 365 workspace the tools may use. Repeatable. |
| `--no-dashboard` | switch |  |
| `--no-doctor` | switch |  |
| `--no-login` | switch |  |
| `--relogin` | switch | Sign in to Nexar again even if the saved login is valid. |
| `--shortcut` | switch | Make a desktop shortcut that runs start for this workspace. |

#### `eda-agent install-scripts`

Copy bundled scripts to a directory of your choice

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--dest` | `DEST` | Destination directory (default: the folder Altium's Global Projects list loads it from, else %USERPROFILE%\EDA Agent\scripts) |
| `--force` | switch | Overwrite existing scripts without prompting |

#### `eda-agent scripts-path`

Print the path to the bundled DelphiScript files

No arguments.

#### `eda-agent relaunch`

Ask the running Altium to run StartMCPServer from the installed script project. Leaves pending requests alone and does nothing if the bridge already answers.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--prjscr` | `PATH` | Script project to run (default: the install-scripts destination). |
| `--dry-run` | switch | Print the command instead of running it. |
| `--force` | switch | Run it even when the bridge answers a ping. |
| `--restart` | switch | Stop the running loop after its current command and start it again (after install-scripts). Other sessions' calls wait through it instead of failing. |

#### `eda-agent update`

Update from your remote or a local folder, and say what is left to do

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--pull` | switch | Also run `git pull --ff-only`. Refused on a dirty tree. |
| `--fetch` | switch | Refresh remote refs first, so 'behind by N' is current rather than from your last fetch. |
| `--check` | switch | Report only; change nothing. |
| `--force-scripts` | switch | Redeploy the Altium scripts even when the versions match. |
| `--from` | `FOLDER\|REMOTE` | Update from a local eda-agent folder (a checkout, a copy on a share, a release directory), or compare against another git remote by name. A path that exists is treated as a folder. |
| `--yes` | switch | Apply the update instead of only reporting: fast-forward this clone, reinstall if the dependencies changed, copy the scripts and restart the Altium loop. |
| `--no-relaunch` | switch | With --yes, leave the Altium loop running the old scripts. |
| `--json` | switch | Print the steps as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent easyeda-extension`

Print where the EasyEDA extension source is (path), or build the .eext to import into EasyEDA Pro (build; needs Node.js).

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `action` | `path`, `build` |  |
| `--out` | `DIR` | Folder to build in. An installed copy is built beside the default workspace unless this is given; a checkout builds in place. |

### Features and dependencies

#### `eda-agent features`

List features and dependencies: installed, missing, versions

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--deep` | switch | Also run the slow checks (openEMS import, versions of programs). |
| `--json` | switch | Machine-readable output. |
| `--on` | `FEATURE` | Switch a switchable feature (an engine) on. |
| `--off` | `FEATURE` | Switch a switchable feature (an engine) off. |

#### `eda-agent install-deps`

Install what features need (all of them with --all)

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `FEATURE` | `FEATURE` | Features to install (see `eda-agent features`). |
| `--all` | switch | Every feature except the development ones. |
| `--dev` | switch | With --all, include the test suite and website tools. |
| `--dry-run` | switch | Show the plan and change nothing. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | switch | Do not ask before installing. |
| `--json` | switch | Machine-readable output. |

### Diagnostics

#### `eda-agent doctor`

Full preflight: workspace + Altium + version + canary IPC calls

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--library` | `PATH` | Optional .SchLib path to test reachability. Repeat for multiple libs. The doctor never crawls; it only tests paths you supply. |
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON instead of the text report. |

#### `eda-agent health`

Fast offline preconditions (workspace, pointer file, scripts)

No arguments.

#### `eda-agent perf`

Report where call time goes, from the workspace's own logs.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON instead of the table. |
| `--limit` | `LIMIT` | How many commands to list (default 15). |

#### `eda-agent compute-status`

Show whether the Rust compute wheel is installed and in use

No arguments.

### Altium SDK reach

#### `eda-agent sdk-coverage`

Report how much of Altium's SDK the property chains reach.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON instead of the table. |
| `--detail` | `N` | List N missing property names per object type. |
| `--sdk-json` | `PATH` | Read a reflected SDK from PATH instead of reference/altium_sdk.json. |

#### `eda-agent sdk-probe`

Ask the running Altium which declared properties it exposes.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--object-type` | `KIND` | Schematic object kind to probe: component, pin, port, netlabel, wire, sheetsymbol, ... (default: component). |
| `--designator` | `REF` | Component to read (default: the first on the active sheet). Components only; every other kind is picked with --index. |
| `--index` | `N` | Which object of that kind on the sheet, from 0. For the kinds that have no designator. |
| `--properties` | `A,B,C` | Probe only these names. Default: every candidate the generator plans for. |
| `--doc-path` | `PATH` | Schematic to read instead of the active one. |
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON instead of a table. |
| `--sdk-json` | `PATH` | Read a reflected SDK from PATH instead of reference/altium_sdk.json. |

#### `eda-agent sdk-symbols`

Report what the scripting engine will resolve, offline.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--refresh` | switch | Re-extract the table from the local install. |
| `--name` | `NAME` | Explain how one member can be reached. |
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON instead of the table. |
| `--sdk-json` | `PATH` | Read a reflected SDK from PATH instead of reference/altium_sdk.json. |

### Owner profiles

#### `eda-agent profile-init`

Scaffold a new owner profile (see docs/PROFILES.md).

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `NAME` | Profile name. |
| `--here` | switch | Scaffold a project-local .eda-agent/profile/ in the current directory instead of a centrally-switchable one. Meant to be committed to that project's own repo. |

#### `eda-agent profile-list`

List central profiles and which one is active.

No arguments.

#### `eda-agent profile-show`

Show the profile actually in effect for the current directory.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON. |

#### `eda-agent profile-use`

Set the centrally active profile.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `NAME` |  |

#### `eda-agent profile-validate`

Load every file in a profile and report errors.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `NAME` | Central profile name (default: whatever resolves here). |
| `--here` | switch | Validate the project-local .eda-agent/profile/ in cwd. |

#### `eda-agent profile-new-project`

Copy a profile's templates/<name>/ tree to a new project directory.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `template` | `TEMPLATE` |  |
| `dest` | `DEST` |  |
| `--force` | switch | Copy into a non-empty destination. Files the template also has are overwritten; anything else already there is left alone (this merges, it does not replace the directory). |

#### `eda-agent phases-show`

Which NPI stages are in force (EVT, DVT, PVT and the rest), and which setting decided it.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON. |

#### `eda-agent phases-enable`

Run the named NPI stages, or all five when none are named. Writes the active profile's phase_gates.json.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `STAGE` | `STAGE` | feasibility, research, prototype, evt, dvt, pvt (also 'design validation' and the other spellings). None means all six. They always run in that order, whatever order you name them. |

#### `eda-agent phases-disable`

Stop running NPI stages. Answers already recorded are kept and come back if the stages do.

No arguments.

#### `eda-agent router-show`

Which autorouter engine routing runs use (default or euan), and which setting decided it.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` | switch | Emit machine-readable JSON. |

#### `eda-agent router-use`

Choose the autorouter engine: 'default', or 'euan' for the alternative router from Euan's fork (off by default). Writes the active profile's router.json.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `engine` | `default`, `euan` | default (the usual router) or euan. |

### Offline analysis (no running Altium)

#### `eda-agent review`

Offline fallback design review of a .SchDoc/.PrjPcb (needs --offline).

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | `FILE` | Path to a .SchDoc sheet or a .PrjPcb project (reviews all its sheets). |
| `--offline` | switch | Opt in to the no-Altium file-reader review. Required (this review is off by default); the live-Altium tools are preferred when a session is available. |
| `--json` | switch | Emit the full report as JSON. |
| `--sarif` | switch | Emit SARIF 2.1.0 (for GitHub code scanning / PR annotations). |
| `--fail-on` | `error`, `warning`, `info`, `never` | Exit non-zero when a finding at or above this severity exists (default: error). |

#### `eda-agent bom`

Offline consolidated BOM from a .SchDoc/.PrjPcb (no running Altium). Opt-in: requires --offline (or EDA_AGENT_HEADLESS_REVIEW=1). Prefer live proj_get_bom.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | `FILE` | A .SchDoc or .PrjPcb. |
| `--offline` | switch | Opt in to the no-Altium reader (required). |
| `--csv` | switch | Emit CSV. |
| `--json` | switch | Emit JSON. |

#### `eda-agent netlist`

Offline netlist reconstruction + connectivity ERC (single_pin_net, net_short) from a .SchDoc (no running Altium). Opt-in: requires --offline. Prefer live proj_get_nets/proj_run_erc.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | `FILE` | A .SchDoc sheet. |
| `--offline` | switch | Opt in to the no-Altium solver (required). |
| `--json` | switch | Emit JSON. |
| `--sarif` | switch | Emit SARIF 2.1.0 (GitHub code scanning / PR annotations). |
| `--fail-on` | `error`, `warning`, `info`, `never` | Exit non-zero on a finding at/above this severity (default: error). |

### Engineering calculators

#### `eda-agent calc`

Run an engineering calculator by name: `eda-agent calc fusing-current width_mils=10`. Bare `eda-agent calc` lists them with the inputs each one takes.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `NAME` | Calculator name. |
| `KEY=VALUE` | `KEY=VALUE` | Inputs, named as the calculator's arguments. |
| `--json` | switch | Emit JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-spacing`

Minimum conductor spacing for a voltage (IPC-2221 Table 6-1)

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--voltage` | `VOLTAGE` | DC or AC peak BETWEEN CONDUCTORS, volts |
| `--environment` | `ENVIRONMENT` | B1 internal, B2 external uncoated, B3 above 3050 m, B4 polymer coated, A5 conformal coated, A6 bare leads, A7 coated leads (default: B2) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-fusing`

Current that MELTS a track in a given time (Onderdonk)

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--width-mils` | `WIDTH_MILS` | Track width, mils |
| `--copper-oz` | `COPPER_OZ` | Copper weight, oz/ft^2 (default: 1.0) |
| `--time-s` | `TIME_S` | Duration, seconds (trust under ~1 s) (default: 1.0) |
| `--ambient-c` | `AMBIENT_C` | Ambient temperature, degC (default: 25.0) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-via`

Via inductance, capacitance and barrel resistance

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--drill-mils` | `DRILL_MILS` | Finished hole diameter, mils |
| `--length-mils` | `LENGTH_MILS` | Barrel length (board thickness), mils |
| `--pad-mils` | `PAD_MILS` | Pad diameter, mils (needed for C) (default: 0.0) |
| `--antipad-mils` | `ANTIPAD_MILS` | Antipad diameter, mils; must exceed the pad (default: 0.0) |
| `--dielectric-constant` | `DIELECTRIC_CONSTANT` | Relative permittivity (default: 4.3) |
| `--plating-mils` | `PLATING_MILS` | Barrel plating thickness, mils (default: 1.0) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-spiral`

Planar spiral inductance (Mohan's modified Wheeler)

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--turns` | `TURNS` | Number of turns |
| `--outer-diameter-mils` | `OUTER_DIAMETER_MILS` | Outer diameter, mils |
| `--inner-diameter-mils` | `INNER_DIAMETER_MILS` | Inner diameter, mils |
| `--shape` | `SHAPE` | square, hexagonal or octagonal (default: square) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-reactance`

Capacitive and inductive reactance at a frequency

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--frequency-hz` | `FREQUENCY_HZ` | Frequency, Hz |
| `--capacitance-f` | `CAPACITANCE_F` | Capacitance, farads (default: 0.0) |
| `--inductance-h` | `INDUCTANCE_H` | Inductance, henries (default: 0.0) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-resonance`

LC resonant frequency and characteristic impedance

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--inductance-h` | `INDUCTANCE_H` | Inductance, henries |
| `--capacitance-f` | `CAPACITANCE_F` | Capacitance, farads |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-wavelength`

Wavelength in a dielectric, with quarter- and twentieth-wave

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--frequency-hz` | `FREQUENCY_HZ` | Frequency, Hz |
| `--dielectric-constant` | `DIELECTRIC_CONSTANT` | Relative permittivity (default: 4.3) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-pdn`

Target power-distribution-network impedance

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--voltage-v` | `VOLTAGE_V` | Rail voltage, volts |
| `--ripple-percent` | `RIPPLE_PERCENT` | Allowed ripple, percent of rail |
| `--transient-current-a` | `TRANSIENT_CURRENT_A` | Transient step, amps |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-padstack`

Pad and antipad diameters, and the gap between neighbours

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--drill-mils` | `DRILL_MILS` | Finished hole diameter, mils |
| `--annular-ring-mils` | `ANNULAR_RING_MILS` | Annular ring, mils |
| `--pitch-mils` | `PITCH_MILS` | Neighbour pitch, mils (default: 0.0) |
| `--clearance-mils` | `CLEARANCE_MILS` | Plane clearance, mils (default: 0.0) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-wire`

AWG wire diameter, area and resistance

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--awg` | `AWG` | Gauge; -1 is 00, -2 is 000, -3 is 0000 |
| `--length-m` | `LENGTH_M` | Length, metres (default: 1.0) |
| `--temperature-c` | `TEMPERATURE_C` | Conductor temperature, degC (default: 20.0) |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full reply as JSON. |

#### `eda-agent calc-cross-check`

Compare a calculator against a locally built pcb-toolkit

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `calculator` | `CALCULATOR` | Function name in engineering.pcb_calc, e.g. ipc2221_spacing |
| `--arg` | `NAME=VALUE` | Argument to pass to both. Repeatable. |
| `--json` | switch | Print the full comparison as JSON. |

### Altium 365

#### `eda-agent altium365-login`

Sign in to Nexar in the browser for the altium365_ tools (needs EDA_AGENT_NEXAR_APP_ID, plus EDA_AGENT_NEXAR_CLIENT_SECRET for a Nexar portal app). The workspace route needs no sign-in: set EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM365_DOMAIN and EDA_AGENT_ALTIUM365_TOKEN.

No arguments.

#### `eda-agent altium365-logout`

Forget the saved Nexar login of altium365-login.

No arguments.

#### `eda-agent altium365-scan-library`

Read a workspace's whole managed library into the active profile (library/<host>/), continuing an unfinished scan.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--workspace` | `WORKSPACE` | Workspace URL (default: the profile's one). |
| `--database-dir` | `DATABASE_DIR` | Keep the database here instead of in the profile. |
| `--workers` | `WORKERS` | Readers on different row ranges at once (1-16). |
| `--restart` | switch | Drop an unfinished scan and start over. |

#### `eda-agent altium365-update-library`

Refresh a scanned library: reread all but its bulk block, and say whether a full scan is needed.

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--workspace` | `WORKSPACE` | Workspace URL (default: the profile's one). |
| `--database-dir` | `DATABASE_DIR` | Keep the database here instead of in the profile. |

### Experimental

#### `eda-agent eco-execute`

EXPERIMENTAL. Auto-press Altium's ECO dialog (needs --confirm).

| Argument | Takes | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | switch | Required. Acknowledges this presses Execute Changes without a human looking at the dialog first. |
| `--validate-only` | switch | Press Validate Changes only; leave Execute Changes/Close for a human to press after reviewing the preview. |
| `--allow-confirm-dialogs` | switch | Also answer yes/no confirmation dialogs encountered along the way (see app_drive_dialogs' allow_confirm). |
| `--wait-first` | `WAIT_FIRST` | Seconds to wait for the ECO dialog to appear (default 60). |
| `--budget` | `BUDGET` | Seconds before giving up on a wedged dialog sequence (default 300). |
